gloss: traditional age counting; East Asian age reckoning

definitions.gloss: traditional age counting; East Asian age reckoning
definitions.explanation: A traditional system of counting age in which a person is one year old at birth and gains a year every New Year's Day, rather than on their birthday.

examples.japanese: {数|かぞ}え{年|どし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧{三十歳|さんじゅっさい}だ。
examples.english: In traditional age counting, I am thirty this year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{七五三|しちごさん}→七五三：06185_shichigosan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{数|かぞ}え{年|どし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{祝|いわ}う→祝う：01881_iwau⟧⟦{家庭|かてい}→家庭：12315_katei⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Some families celebrate Shichi-Go-San based on traditional age counting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{数|かぞ}え{年|どし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一般的|いっぱんてき}→一般的：04784_ippanteki⟧だった⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{満年齢|まんねんれい}→満年齢：23904_mannenrei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{使|つか}われている→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: In the past, traditional age counting was common, but now the Western system is used.

notes:
Under this system, a baby is considered one year old ({一歳|いっさい}) at birth, and everyone becomes one year older on January 1st (originally based on the lunar new year). This means a person born on December 31st would be considered two years old on the following day.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {数|かぞ}え{年|どし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: in traditional age counting
- {数|かぞ}え{年|どし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{年齢|ねんれい}→年齢：01490_nenrei⟧: age by traditional reckoning
- {数|かぞ}え{年|どし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{祝|いわ}う→祝う：01881_iwau⟧: to celebrate by traditional age

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{満年齢|まんねんれい}→満年齢：23904_mannenrei⟧: Western-style age — counting from birthday to birthday, which is the standard system in modern Japan

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japan officially switched to the Western age system (⟦{満年齢|まんねんれい}→満年齢：23904_mannenrei⟧) in 1950, but {数|かぞ}え{年|どし} is still used for some traditional events like ⟦{厄年|やくどし}→厄年：05809_yakudoshi⟧ (unlucky years) and ⟦{還暦|かんれき}→還暦：05807_kanreki⟧ (60th birthday celebration).
